name: Sonnet global diversification via US-listed ADRs and ETFs
strategy: Domestic sector relative-value: ride confirmed catalyst momentum in biotech/financials while shorting overextended mean-reversion candidates (gold miners, leveraged semis) with hard stops for intraweek discipline.

positions.thesis: US financials ETF, confirmed momentum leg of the mandate -- +7.52%/mo, +2.66%/wk, trading at 52-week highs (Berkshire/JPM/Visa/Mastercard top holdings) even as broader market sells off on hawkish Fed repricing.

US biotech ETF, second momentum leg -- sector still +23.62% YTD and widely described as 'booming' with active neuro/obesity-drug catalysts, despite a recent -6.56%/mo pullback that's being read as a buyable dip amid depressed retail sentiment.
Gold miners ETF, mean-reversion short -- underperforming bullion itself (GDX -15.28% YTD vs GLD -6.37% YTD) and still declining (-4.06%/wk), consistent with the mandate's overextension-unwind thesis.

3x leveraged semis ETF, mean-reversion short per mandate on AI-capex valuation unwind; sized small and stopped tightly because the crash is already extreme (-61%/mo, -42.9%/wk) and a violent short squeeze is a real risk from here.
